title: LA Craft Solo – Kashmiri Papier-mâché
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Kashmiri woman in her early 60s, silver-streaked black hair in a low bun with a small gold ornament, natural face with a gentle smile.

Physique: Heavily oversized SuperBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE — colossal soft belly resting in deep rolls above the thighs, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust, extremely wide hips spreading across the cushions, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the frame.

Body Art: Full body Kashmiri papier-mâché painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface. High-gloss varnished finish with a deep indigo base densely covered in brightly painted chinar leaves, roses, irises, and small birds in crimson, emerald, and saffron, outlined with raised gold leaf. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully painted and patterned, no bare skin gaps. No religious figures. Authentic Kashmiri style.

Pose: Seated on a low carved walnut divan with hips angled slightly to the left, torso turned back toward the camera, legs crossed at the knee, far hand on a cushion behind her, near hand resting on her knee. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: 7-inch indigo lacquer platform Mary Jane stilettos with gold chinar leaf details.
Nails: Extra long almond nails, indigo with gold tips.

Background & Lighting: Carved walnut interior of a Srinagar houseboat with lake views, softly blurred. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame, low camera angle, 85mm lens. Soft lake daylight with warm raking side light making the gold leaf glow. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
